name: ACA 219 询问天气 能见差复飞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air Canada 219, from Vancouver to Wuhan, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3555, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air Canada 219，从 Vancouver 到 Wuhan，保持 11000 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 3555，与 武汉管制 建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA219, maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3555.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA219，保持 11000 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 3555。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, reduce speed to mach 0.75 due flow control.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，由于流量控制，减速到马赫 0.75。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to less than 270 knots until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，下降到 9200 米，减速到 270 节以下，直到通知。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to less than 270 knots until advised, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 9200 米，减速到 270 节以下，直到通知，ACA219。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your TCAS indicates there is a converging traffic at your 2 o'clock, below, climbing, confirm with Wuhan Control if it is in conflict with you.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 下降过程中，你的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有交叉交通，在下方，正在爬升，向武汉管制确认是否与你冲突。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA219, our TCAS indicates there is a converging traffic at our 2 o'clock, below, climbing, is it in conflict with us ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA219，我们的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有交叉交通，在我们下方，正在爬升，是否与我们冲突？

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, negative, the aircraft is climbing to 8900 meters, it will cross behind your shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，否，该飞机正在爬升到 8900 米，很快将在你后方穿越。

cards.audioText: B: You have just received the latest ATIS, saying the visibility at Wuhan is low, you want to know if your alternate airport Changsha is available for diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你刚收到最新 ATIS，说 Wuhan 能见度低，你想知道备降机场 Changsha 是否可用于改航。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA219, the latest ATIS says the visibility at Wuhan is low, is Changsha available for diversion ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA219，最新 ATIS 说 Wuhan 能见度低，Changsha 是否可用于改航？

cards.audioText:
C: Air Canada 219, Changsha Airport is available, confirm you are diverting to Changsha?
B: Tell the controller you are not diverting to Changsha at the moment, and you still want to fly to Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 219，Changsha Airport 可用，确认你要改航 Changsha？
B: 告诉管制员目前不改航 Changsha，仍想飞往 Wuhan。
cards.referenceText: We won't divert at the moment, we still want to fly to Wuhan, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们目前不改航，仍想飞往 Wuhan，ACA219。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, roger, track direct to Zulu Foxtrot, follow Zulu Foxtrot 2 Alpha arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，收到，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 2 Alpha 进场，预计跑道 36R ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to ZF, follow ZF2A arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，执行 ZF2A 进场，预计跑道 36R ILS 进近，ACA219。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，下降并保持 4200 米，减速到最小光洁速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，减速到最小光洁速度，ACA219。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, contact Wuhan Tower 119.6.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，联系武汉塔台119.6。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established on ILS approach runway 36 right, you are 15 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，距接地点 15 海里，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, established on ILS approach runway 36R, 15 miles from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA219，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，距接地点 15 海里。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, roger, surface wind calm, RVR touchdown 550 meters, midpoint 600 meters, rollout 500 meters, continue approach runway 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，收到，地面风静风，RVR 接地点 550 米，中段 600 米，停止端 500 米，继续进近跑道 36R。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are 10 miles from touchdown, ask Wuhan Tower for the cloud information.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你距接地点 10 海里，向武汉塔台询问云况信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, 10 miles from touchdown, request cloud information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA219，距接地点 10 海里，请求云况信息。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land runway 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，疏云 700 米，可以着陆跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land runway 36R, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 疏云 700 米，可以着陆跑道 36R，ACA219。

cards.audioText: B: At the minimum, you are unable to see approach lights, you are carrying out a missed approach, advice Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 在最低标准高度，你看不到进近灯，正在执行复飞，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText:
Wuhan Tower, ACA219, we are unable to see approach lights at minimum, going around.
         (no contact at the minimum)
cards.referenceTextZh:
武汉塔台，ACA219，我们在最低标准高度看不到进近灯，复飞。
         （最低标准高度无目视）

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 219,roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advice intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，收到，执行标准复飞程序，可以时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, ACA219.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are climbing to missed approach altitude, you decide to divert to Changsha Airport, informe Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你正在爬升到复飞高度，决定改航 Changsha Airport，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, request divert to Changsha Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA219，请求改航 Changsha Airport。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, roger, turn right, direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, climb to and maintain 2400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，收到，右转，直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar，爬升并保持 2400 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 LKO，爬升并保持 2400 米，ACA219。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, contact Wuhan Departure on 120.4.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，联系 Wuhan Departure 120.4。
